name: analyze_trace_fault
description: High-level A/B variant: given a trace_id, walk errors, topology, and the critical path internally and return a pre-summarized fault analysis. Not registered in server.go — the harness composes get_trace_errors + get_trace_topology + get_critical_path so this schema can be A/B'd without forking Jaeger. Skills compose reviewed tools (#8440); promoting this into registerTools is a possible outcome of the experiment, not a prerequisite.

originating_error.description: Deepest error span with no errored children, drawn from get_trace_errors + get_trace_topology

path.description: Slash-delimited span IDs from root to this span (get_trace_topology.path)

propagation_chain.description: Ancestor spans from originating_error to the root, topology order

critical_path_hotspots.description: get_critical_path segments with the highest self_time_us

total_error_count.description: Uncapped error count from get_trace_errors; compare with how much of originating_error was actually retrieved

truncated.description: True if any underlying tool hit MaxSpanDetailsPerRequest
